name: unique
statement: A[X]} (pmonic : p.Monic) (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) (pmin : ∀ q : A[X], q.Monic → Polynomial.aeval x q = 0 → degree p ≤ degree q) : p = minpoly A x

name: dvd
statement: A[X]} (hp : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) : minpoly A x ∣ p

name: eq_of_irreducible
statement: A[X]} (hp1 : Irreducible p) (hp2 : Polynomial.aeval x p = 0) : p * C p.leadingCoeff⁻¹ = minpoly A x

name: add_algebraMap
statement: Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (x : B) (a : A) : minpoly A (x + algebraMap A B a) = (minpoly A x).comp (X - C a)

name: neg
statement: Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra A B] (x : B) : minpoly A (-x) = (-1) ^ (natDegree (minpoly A x)) * (minpoly A x).comp (-X)

name: root
statement: B} (hx : IsIntegral A x) {y : A} (h : IsRoot (minpoly A x) y) : algebraMap A B y = x

name: coeff_zero_eq_zero
statement: IsIntegral A x) : coeff (minpoly A x) 0 = 0 ↔ x = 0
